name: Code Review
description: Systematic code review with router-based sub-skill selection.
short_description: Route to the right review aspect — correctness, security, errors, or maintainability.
store_description: A router-based code review skill. The parent routes to one of four specialized sub-skills based on the user's request: correctness analysis (bugs and logic), security audit (injection, auth, secrets), error handling review (exceptions, retries, fallbacks), and maintainability review (complexity, duplication, naming). Every finding is backed by a quoted excerpt and a concrete fix recommendation.

sub_skills.description: Identify logic bugs, edge cases, off-by-one errors, and incorrect control flow with cited evidence.
Identify security vulnerabilities — injection, secrets, auth bypass, unsafe deserialization.
Review exception hierarchies, retry logic, fallbacks, and error propagation for robustness.
Review code for clarity, coupling, duplication, naming, and future-change cost.

examples.expected_outcome: Router selects security_audit; findings grouped by severity with payloads.

examples.context: User attached a large file without specifying an aspect.
examples.expected_outcome: Router selects the most relevant sub-skill based on request content.
